summary: Iteration 46: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Public Status Page + Incident Notes feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed. Frontend: full admin flow (toggle, title blur-save, copy link, view link), diagnostics seeding, incidents panel, note save + toast, public /status unauthenticated render with all 4 subsystem groups, incidents visibility, and disabled-state rendering all verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: deploy_center.py file is ~880 lines and violates the >700-line guideline; consider splitting diagnostics, deploy bundle, alerts/incidents, and status-page endpoints into separate modules for maintainability.
public_status endpoint recomputes uptime by scanning the entire diagnostics_history collection per request; consider caching or precomputing rolling uptime as history grows.
seed_data_creation: Ran diagnostics to seed diagnostics_history + diagnostics_alerts; saved TEST_UI_iter46 notes on latest alerts; status_page setting toggled during test then re-enabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 6 pytest cases cover PUT/GET /api/admin/deploy/status-page, GET /api/status/public (unauth) enabled+disabled paths, PATCH /api/admin/deploy/diagnose/alerts/{id}/note happy path + 404, admin-required guard. Frontend confirmed: /admin -> 'Deployment' tab exposes status-page-card, incidents-toggle-btn, incident-log-panel with incident-note-input-<id>/save-<id>, run-diagnose-btn. Public /status page at /status renders overall banner, 4 groups (platform/ai/calls/email) with uptime strips + %, and status-incidents section with saved notes; shows status-disabled when admin toggle is OFF. Feature is stable.
